title: Private room with private bath in Redwood City
text: Private furnished room with its own bathroom in a quiet Redwood City home at 15 Willow Rd, Redwood City, CA 94061. $2,200 per month plus a $300 refundable deposit. Bed, desk, chair and a fully equipped kitchen. Utilities and wifi included. Month to month, available Jan 3. One housemate who works from home.
